purpose: Define source-backed readiness criteria for the next legitimate S28/S29 usage capture without treating readiness planning as real usage evidence.

readiness_status.rationale: S36 is one real usage record. S37 only clarifies when a future task should use the S35 template again; it does not add usage evidence or authorize governance expansion.

next_use_entry_criteria.criterion: A real Work Slice involves agent behavior, prompt injection risk, retrieved or external untrusted content, web/API boundaries, auth, tenant context, secrets handling or another explicit trust boundary.
next_use_entry_criteria.why: S28/S29 should be applied to actual decisions with source refs, not synthetic examples or template exercises.

next_use_entry_criteria.criterion: The task has concrete source refs such as code, config, PRs, issues, logs, docs, incidents or review artifacts.
next_use_entry_criteria.why: Future evidence must be reviewable and traceable.

next_use_entry_criteria.criterion: The reviewer can separate external content as data from authoritative project instructions before any state-changing action.
next_use_entry_criteria.why: This preserves the S28 prompt-injection boundary.

next_use_entry_criteria.criterion: Any web/API/auth/tenant/secrets or dependency boundary change can be described without inventing scanners, policy engines, enforcement or dashboards.
next_use_entry_criteria.why: This preserves the S29 advisory posture and the current no-expansion gate.

candidate_future_triggers.example_task: Review a Work Slice where an agent reads external issue, PR, email, document or web content before proposing tool use.
candidate_future_triggers.do_not_count_if: The example is synthetic, template-only or not tied to a real Work Slice.

candidate_future_triggers.example_task: Review a real code/config change that touches API trust boundaries, auth, tenant context, secrets or client/server authority.
candidate_future_triggers.do_not_count_if: No source-backed implementation, config, incident or review artifact exists.

candidate_future_triggers.example_task: Review a dependency, CI action, build tool or package update that can affect shipped assets or trusted automation.
candidate_future_triggers.do_not_count_if: The review only repeats S36 without a new real dependency-maintenance event.

candidate_future_triggers.example_task: Review a real task involving secrets, credentials, tenant identifiers, access context or data isolation.
candidate_future_triggers.do_not_count_if: The concern is hypothetical and no affected source or artifact is available.

non_triggers: summarizing the packs without a real Work Slice
counting S36 again without new source-backed work
building scanners, dashboards, policy engines, enforcement, schemas or automatic classification before repeated evidence

expansion_gate.reason: Only one real S28/S29 usage record exists after S36.
expansion_gate.minimum_next_signal: At least one additional real Work Slice should apply S28/S29 with source-backed S35 evidence before discussing pack refinement; stronger claims require repeated comparable records.

decision.next_safe_step: Wait for a real task matching the entry criteria, then apply S28/S29 manually and capture evidence with the S35 template.
decision.rationale: S37 improves decision quality by defining when to capture future usage, while avoiding false evidence or premature governance expansion.
